title: CMA Awards tomorrow: Ella Langley leads the nominations as Lainey Wilson hosts
summary: Taylor Swift is among the performers at country music's biggest night in Nashville.
body:
The 60th CMA Awards take place tomorrow, Wednesday 18 November, at Bridgestone Arena in Nashville, with Lainey Wilson hosting for the third time.

Ella Langley leads the nominations with nine, including Entertainer of the Year and Album of the Year for Dandelion. Miranda Lambert has seven, and Kacey Musgraves and Ben West have five each.

Performers

Taylor Swift will perform at the ceremony for the first time since 2013. Other performers include Kacey Musgraves, Ella Langley and Tim McGraw, and there will be a tribute to Dolly Parton.

The show will be broadcast live on ABC and streamed on Disney+.

Sources: ABC News, Billboard.
